d: Station 51's mascot, Boot, won't eat; accidents befall a woman attempting to cook a meal; a man nearly dies from an aspirin overdose.
The paramedics conduct several rescues under a shadow of guilt after being accused of stealing from a patient; guest Jo Anne Worley.
DeSoto must decide whether to amputate the leg of a trapped construction worker (James McEachin); nervous Gage faces an IRS tax audit.
An assembly bill to create a paramedic program meets opposition from doctors and firefighters; pilot for the series.
Mercenaries capture B.A., Face and Murdock, and hold them at a dairy farm, leaving Tawnia and Hannibal to devise a rescue.
The team abides by a cult's nonviolent philosophy to defeat corrupt townspeople who burned their community building.
The team recalls incidents of Murdock's bravery and loyalty while he lies badly wounded by a bullet meant for Hannibal.
The team flies to Miami to wage war against gangsters threatening to take over a resort hotel owned by two sisters.
Tawnia recruits the team to save her adventurer fiancé, captured by Amazon River pirates while searching for a lost city.
The captured team discovers a secret in the jungle and must enlist El Cajon's assistance to destroy a deadly installation.
The team helps a fire chief (Stepfanie Kramer) save her one-truck company from takeover by a larger operation.
The team helps brother-and-sister lumberjacks thwart a crooked union boss intent on driving them out of business.
The team interrupts a war between crime syndicates to rescue a government witness's (Dana Elcar) daughter (Leah Ayres).
Banner must go to the police to save a former Vietnam hero from a sniper.
Self-experimentation releases Banner's primitive impulses; guest Rosemary Forsyth.
A corrupt politician sabotages an aerial exhibition team employing Banner; guest Sam Groom.
Banner investigates legends of another scientist, dead 30 years, who underwent a Hulk-type metamorphosis.
To save a wounded immigrant boy, Banner poses as a visiting priest; guests Henry Darrow, Diana Muldaur.
A factory owner in debt to the mob labels Banner as his partner.
